description: Salary benchmarks (yearly, USD) computed from startup.jobs listings that disclose compensation, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns an aggregate over the last 12 months; full access unlocks the monthly time series and company-level benchmarks.

months.description: How many months of history (default 12, full access only)

role.description: Role slug from list_roles (specific roles only, not top-level categories)

name: salary_benchmarks
title: Salary benchmarks
